title: Exchange complexes and contractibility of the complex of incompressible Seifert surfaces
summary: Let $K\subset S^3$ be a non-trivial knot and let $\mathrm{IS}(K)$ be the simplicial complex whose vertices are the ambient isotopy classes of incompressible Seifert surfaces in the exterior $E(K)$, a finite set of distinct vertices spanning a simplex exactly when its classes admit simultaneously pairwise disjoint representatives. Kakimizu proved that $\mathrm{IS}(K)$ is connected; whether it is contractible was asked by Przytycki and Schultens, who also identified the obstruction, namely that the projection used in the connectedness proof is not known to be well defined on isotopy classes.…
